metadata.title: Quandle coloring quivers of pretzel links
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we conduct a systematic study of quandle colorings and quandle coloring quivers for pretzel links using the dihedral quandle $\mathbb{Z}_{n}$. First, we systematically investigate all possible colorings of 3-pretzel links, determining the number of distinct colorings in each case as well as the structure of their quandle coloring quivers. In order to obtain more general conclusions, we impose restrictions on $n$ based on the properties of the coefficient matrix of the system of congruence equations. So we examine the number of quandle colorings and the quandle coloring quivers for 4-pretzel links in the case where $n$ is prime. Finally, Combining the results of 4-pretzel links we rigorously derive both the coloring numbers and quandle coloring quivers for general $m$-pretzel links in the case where $n$ is prime, with full proofs provided.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: Pretzel 链环的 quandle 染色箭图
analysis.workSummary: 系统计算二面体 quandle Z_n 对三股 pretzel 链环的染色及箭图；在 n 为素数时推广到四股和一般 m 股情形。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出可显式计算的多股 pretzel 链环增强不变量。
analysis.limitations: 一般 m 股结果要求素数模数，不能套用于任意合数 n。
analysis.priorityReason: 给出可显式计算的多股 pretzel 链环增强不变量。
